sections.heading: Each {{entity_noun}} you identify qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it:

rules.text: The record's mentions evidence the {{entity_noun}} you identified — it is named, described, or clearly implied by what the mentions say, not merely suggested by a resemblance between words.

children.text: Whose {{entity_noun}} it is has no bearing here. A candidate evidenced by a customer's, supplier's, or any other third party's dealings is still identified and recorded.

A {{entity_noun}} must actually be determinable: mentions that speak of {{entity_noun}}s only in general terms, with nothing that fixes which one, identify none. Where the record names a specific form or designation of a {{entity_noun}}, identify the {{entity_noun}} it is a form of. An object, part, or assembly made of a {{entity_noun}} is not itself the {{entity_noun}} — identify the {{entity_noun}} only where the record names which one it is made of.

rules.text: The {{entity_noun}} you identified is of the kind {{entity_noun}} names, judged against what {{entity_noun}} means. A process or treatment, an object or part made of one, a capability, or anything else outside that meaning does not qualify, however clearly the record evidences it.

Neither the provided options nor the record's already-identified results cover the {{entity_noun}} you identified: no option matches it exactly or under different words, judged against {{option_evidence}}, and it does not restate an already-identified result.
